name: Basis-regime spike reversion — perp-discount blowout snap-back (long, 1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the mirror of the premium fade. perp_spot_basis blowing out to an extreme NEGATIVE spike means perp SELLERS are so aggressive they underprice vs spot — a transient discount the funding mechanism (the restoring force) pulls back toward zero. Arb desks have finite intraday capacity, so the discount over-shoots before they close it. We buy the perp cheapness on SPOT (direction +1) and, because funding is negative here, a long RECEIVES the carry (funding_feature) while basis mechanically converges up. funding_rate confirming (negative) rules out a stale basis print. Distinct from steady negative-carry harvesting (variant 07/08 which needs an oversold price washout too): this is purely the transient basis over-shoot with no price-washout gate. Hold ~0.25-0.5d. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the mean basis is compressed near zero so 'extreme' discounts are noise inside bid-ask + fees. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if it is inseparable from the negative-funding long (basis and funding near-collinear) — keep the stronger. DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if convergence is slower than the hold and swamped by a downtrend.
catalyst: perp basis spikes to an extreme discount with negative funding — a mechanical over-shoot to buy long.
